lastCompletedStory.title: Target the orchestrator pane with an explicit size in openPaneInSession

nextStoryContext: US-002 is the real-tmux oracle for the geometry fix landed in US-001. The argv-shape tests now assert -t <pane-id> and -l 60%, but only a real-tmux round-trip can prove the geometry actually applies. The integration test in ensure-worker-pane-selfheal.test.ts was updated to pass the surviving orch pane as targetPaneId; US-002 may need a dedicated geometry-verification test.

officialDocsValidated.summary: split-window -l accepts trailing % for percentage; -t accepts pane id like %0; -v is default but we specify explicitly; -P -F #{pane_id} prints only the pane id. All confirmed matching implementation.
